Source. `parse_option()` consumes the witness's `--ogg` argv entry and sets the Ogg-mode dispatch flag that later makes `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()` reject decode-position queries.

The witness also supplies `--sk` followed by `1`. The local `share__getopt_long()` implementation accepts unambiguous long-option prefixes, so this token reaches the `skip` case and preserves the sample skip as string `"1"`.
The extracted short-option cluster `-Fa` eventually reaches case `'a'`, forcing decode mode and analysis mode. This is the only state that enters the `dpos` block in `write_callback`.
Parsing the carried string `"1"` yields `value_is_samples = true`, `is_relative = false`, and `spec->value.samples = 1`.

Because step 2 forced Ogg mode, `decode_file()` initializes the stream decoder through `FLAC__stream_decoder_init_ogg_file()`, and init stores `decoder->private_->is_ogg = true`. This is the exact state checked later by `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()`.
After metadata decoding, the parsed skip remains positive. This branch sees `value.samples == 1` and calls `FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute(d->decoder, 1)` before normal end-of-stream decoding.
With step 6's Ogg flag set and step 7's `sample == 1`, seek dispatches into `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_`. This exact Ogg arm appears in the saved MSan stack.

During Ogg seeking, the decoded frame covering target sample 1 takes this target-frame branch and invokes `write_callback` instead of returning `CONTINUE`. The saved stack reaches `write_callback` through this function.

Because step 4 enabled analysis mode and step 9 called into `write_callback`, execution enters the analysis block and allocates local `dpos`. MemorySanitizer names this stack slot as the uninitialized origin.
Root cause. The boolean result is ignored, so the caller assumes `dpos` was initialized even though the same library explicitly refuses decode-position queries on Ogg decoders.
Because step 6 set `decoder->private_->is_ogg = true`, this callee returns `false` before any `*position` store or tell callback. The `dpos` slot from step 10 therefore remains unwritten.
Unsafe propagation. The subtraction consumes still-uninitialized `dpos` and poisons `frame_bytes`.
Second propagation. The same unwritten `dpos` also overwrites `decoder_session->decode_position`, poisoning the later frame-offset argument.

Sink. This call consumes both poisoned scalars from steps 13-14 as the analysis-frame offset and size. The saved default MSan trace reports `use-of-uninitialized-value` at this exact line and attributes the origin to `dpos` at line 1235.
